beaconVectors.description: Session-start beacon: seq 0, no echo received yet — flags 0 and all-zero lastEcho bytes.
beaconVectors.name: beacon-first

beaconVectors.description: Steady-state beacon reporting the previous echo; every field distinct so an endianness or offset slip is visible byte-by-byte. Matches the hand-computed anchor in ClockBeaconTests.
beaconVectors.name: beacon-steady

beaconVectors.description: All counters and clocks at their u32/u64 maxima.
beaconVectors.name: beacon-seq-max

beaconVectors.description: Every field distinct. Matches the hand-computed anchor in ClockBeaconTests.
beaconVectors.name: echo-nominal

beaconVectors.description: The README's offset/RTT worked example: t1=1,000,000 t2=1,253,000 t3=1,253,500 (t4=1,008,500 lives in clockWorkedExample).
beaconVectors.name: echo-worked-example

beaconVectors.description: Reserved flag bit 7 set: decodes identically to beacon-steady, canonical re-encode differs.
beaconVectors.name: beacon-reserved-flags-ignored

beaconVectors.description: 35 bytes: the beacon is exactly its fixed layout, nothing rides behind it.
beaconVectors.name: beacon-trailing-byte

beaconVectors.description: An echo's type byte (0x02) fed to the beacon decoder at beacon length: a CTRL dispatcher's misrouting is loud.
beaconVectors.name: beacon-bad-type

beaconVectors.description: flags bit0 clear but a lastEcho byte non-zero — some other layer's fill bug, kept loud (the FecField none rule).
beaconVectors.name: beacon-nonzero-absent-echo

clockWorkedExample.description: True offset (client − host) 250,000 µs; forward path 3,000 µs, reverse 5,000 µs, client turnaround 500 µs. t1=1,000,000 (beacon hostSend), t2=1,253,000 (clientReceive), t3=1,253,500 (clientSend), t4=1,008,500 (host receive, measured locally). rtt = (t4−t1)−(t3−t2) = 8,000. offset = ((t2−t1)+(t3−t4))/2 = 249,000 — 1,000 µs shy of truth, exactly the path asymmetry / 2 the timing doc's min-filter accepts.

feedbackVectors.description: Every section populated small: two channel ledgers, a three-packet dispersion train, one NACK (frame 0x000a0b0c, shards 0+2 → bitmap 0x05), one unknown TLV. Matches the hand-computed anchor in FeedbackReportTests.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-nominal

feedbackVectors.description: A quiet window: header only, 21 bytes, dispersionBase zero by rule.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-empty-sections

feedbackVectors.description: Every bound at its maximum — 8 channel blocks, 112 samples, 6 NACKs with full 32-byte bitmaps — the 1035 B structural ceiling, inside the 1112 B shard budget.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-bounds-maxed

feedbackVectors.description: Bounds-maxed plus a 74-byte TLV: exactly 1112 bytes, the largest legal report.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-full-budget

feedbackVectors.description: Reserved flag bit 7 set: decodes identically to feedback-nominal, canonical re-encode differs.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-reserved-flags-ignored

feedbackVectors.description: A 2^24 µs sample delta: does not fit the u24 field, rejected rather than silently truncated.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-delta-overflow

feedbackVectors.description: Bounds-maxed plus a 75-byte TLV: 1113 bytes, one over the 1112 B plaintext shard budget.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-over-budget-tlv

feedbackVectors.description: sampleCount byte says 200, bound is 112: rejected on the count itself, before any section parsing.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-sample-count-over-bounds

feedbackVectors.description: dispersionBase non-zero with sampleCount 0 — a fill bug, kept loud.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-nonzero-base-no-samples

feedbackVectors.description: A NACK entry with bitmapByteCount 0: a NACK must name at least one shard.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-nack-bitmap-count-zero

feedbackVectors.description: bitmapByteCount 33: 32 bytes already covers the whole 255-shard GF(2^8) block.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-nack-bitmap-count-oversize

feedbackVectors.description: A two-byte bitmap whose final byte is zero: the bitmap is sized by its highest set bit.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-nack-bitmap-noncanonical

feedbackVectors.description: One byte past the report's end: the payload is exactly the report.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-trailing-bytes

feedbackVectors.description: feedback-nominal with the TLV value's last byte cut.
feedbackVectors.name: feedback-truncated-tlv
